facts.statement: Eromangasaurus is an extinct genus of elasmosaurid plesiosaur found in northern Queensland, Australia.
facts.quote: Eromangasaurus is an extinct genus of elasmosaurid known from northern Queensland of Australia.

facts.statement: Benjamin P. Kear first named the genus Eromangasaurus in 2005, with Eromangasaurus australis as the type species.
facts.quote: Eromangasaurus was first named by Benjamin P. Kear in 2005 and the type species is Eromangasaurus australis.

facts.statement: Eromangasaurus was a large elasmosaurid reaching 7 meters in length and weighing between 1 and 2 metric tons.
facts.quote: Eromangasaurus is a large elasmosaurid, measuring 7 m in length and weighing 1 - 2 MT.

facts.statement: Eromangasaurus primarily fed on clams and snails.
facts.quote: Eromangasaurus fed mainly on clams and snails.

facts.statement: Eromangasaurus is classified within the family Elasmosauridae.
The time range for Eromangasaurus is the Albian stage, spanning from 106.3 to 100.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (106.3 to 100.5 million years ago)
